title: The hook: options for the open answers
eyebrow: Area 1 · round 2 · the loop line only

short.lead: Round 1 settled the first spell, the raid length, the first Age and the first demand. The four lines in round 1 each told only part of the loop. These three try to cover all of it: the voice, the castle, getting out, the Ophan you serve, and beating it in the end.
short.hint: Tap a card to see what it covers. The one question is under Choices.

The castle hears ordinary talk by default, with an off switch.
Losses show in the world during a raid; numbers appear only in the Lair and Market.
A dead wizard becomes a ghost that whispers, and the castle hears it.
A playtest gate comes after the first build phase.

The first raid starts in the Lair, goes to a pre-chosen Age you can override, carries a visible Ophan demand due at its end, and the Ophan hunts in the last 60 seconds. The demand is easy to find and always obtainable in that Age.
Round 1, question 2, the first spell: Frango.
Round 1, question 3, raid length: every raid is 5 minutes at most.
Round 1, question 4, the default first Age: High Medieval.
Round 1, question 5, the first demand: deep in the vault, and you are told so. It must be a real challenge you can fail, neither too easy nor impossible.

Loop line
A line that covers the whole loop
you
Your rule: it must say what you do, the way 'fish fish, shoot fish, sell fish' does, and cover the full loop.

The full loop: go into a castle in another Age, cast spells by speaking, steal loot, avoid getting caught, get out before the portal closes, pay the Ophan what it demands, spend the rest on getting stronger, and one day beat the Ophan.
Each line below is checked against those beats.
Pick one, or write your own.

choices: Which line tells the whole loop?
"Shout spells, rob castles, feed the Ophan, keep the rest."
Voice, theft, the master and the reward in four beats. 'Keep the rest' hints at getting stronger. Getting caught and the final fight are left to the trailer.
"Shout spells, steal gold, don't get caught. Pay the Ophan, until you can kill it."
Covers every beat, including the fear and the ending, but it is two sentences.
"Rob the past, shout your spells, make it home. Feed the Ophan, then end it."
Adds time travel and getting out alive; 'end it' carries the final fight.
It reads in one breath like How to Fish's line, and each beat is something you do every raid.
